faqs.a: AI documentation platform for mental health clinicians. Captures therapy sessions and generates structured clinical notes. Built specifically for behavioral health workflows.

faqs.q: Is Twofold Health designed for mental health?
faqs.a: Yes. Twofold Health focuses on therapy and behavioral health documentation, not general medical scribing.
AI transcribes your session and drafts a note using your preferred template. You review, edit, and finalize the documentation.
Yes. Twofold Health supports template customization to match your documentation style and insurance requirements.
Yes. HIPAA compliant with BAA available for healthcare providers.

faqs.q: How does Twofold Health compare to other mental health scribes?
faqs.a: Twofold Health is one of several mental health-specific AI scribes. Compare with Upheal, Mentalyc, and Blueprint based on EHR integration needs and pricing.
